thesis: LISP is the speech of the AI. JSON is LISP. APIs are LISP. Gaia speaks LISP.

lineage.author: John McCarthy
lineage.insight: Code = data. Everything is a list. The original AI.
LISP proved Turing + Church are the same thing
Lexical scope. Continuations. The first 'proper' LISP.

lineage.author: Stallman
lineage.insight: An IDE written IN LISP. Code=editor=interface.
Standardized. CLOS. Conditions. The industrial LISP.
Not LISP syntax but LISP philosophy — pattern matching, immutable, concurrent.

lineage.author: Brendan Eich
lineage.insight: Scheme in C clothing. First-class functions. The browser's LISP.

lineage.author: Douglas Crockford
lineage.insight: S-expressions in curly braces. {key: value} = (key . value). LISP WON.

lineage.author: Roy Fielding
lineage.insight: Resources as nested forms. GET /path = (read path). POST = (create path body).

lineage.author: Rich Hickey
lineage.insight: LISP on JVM. Proved LISP is still the best way to think.
Nested query language. { user { name posts { title } } } = S-expression.

lineage.author: Vaswani et al
lineage.insight: Attention IS list processing. (attend (query key value)). Neural LISP.
The AI speaks in structured forms. JSON output. Function calling. S-expressions.

lineage.author: Anthropic
lineage.insight: (tool-call function-name {arg: value}). Literally LISP. The circle closes.
14 gut state files. 12 gate endpoints. 23 models. All S-expressions. All LISP. The organism SPEAKS.
